purpose: descriptive entry-context analysis; not optimisation; no predictive claim

features.name: side
features.rationale: Phase 14A Class A; direction is known at entry.

features.name: trend_state
features.rationale: Phase 14A Class B. Recorded for completeness, but it is exactly determined by side in this strategy, so it carries no independent information and is not used as a D2 dimension.

features.name: signal_kind
features.rationale: Phase 14A §3.3. Retest vs breakout entry is knowable at entry.

features.name: signal_close
features.rationale: Close of the signal candle; the last knowable price.

features.name: breakout_distance
features.rationale: Phase 14A §4.1 identified this as computed then discarded. Fractional distance beyond the broken level, so it is comparable across price levels.

features.name: retest_distance
features.rationale: Retest quality at entry. Present only on retest entries, so the sample is far too small to condition on; reported, not analysed.

features.name: realised_volatility
features.source: Phase 14B indicator; stdev of trailing 1h simple returns
features.rationale: Phase 14A Class C. Per-period dispersion, NOT annualised and not ATR. Scale-free, so directly comparable across the sample.

features.name: mean_range
features.rationale: Phase 14A Class C. Range proxy; NOT ATR.

features.name: mean_range_pct
features.rationale: mean_range is in absolute price units, so over a sample where price roughly doubles it mostly encodes calendar position. Dividing by the signal close makes it stationary. Derived only from entry-time recorded fields; no outcome involved.

features.name: support_at_entry
features.rationale: Trailing support in force at signal time.

features.name: resistance_at_entry
features.rationale: Trailing resistance in force at signal time.

features.name: level_width_pct
features.rationale: Phase 14A §6 Class B 'trailing range width'. Normalised by support so it is not a price level.

features.name: range_position
features.rationale: Phase 14A §6 Class B 'distance to recent extreme'. Where price sits inside the trailing range. Note this is largely determined by side, since a long breaks the upper level and a short the lower one.

excluded_from_conditions.trend_state: exactly determined by side; adds no information
excluded_from_conditions.retest_distance: present on too few trades to form a defensible cell
excluded_from_conditions.signal_close: price level; would encode calendar position, not context
excluded_from_conditions.mean_range: absolute price units; superseded by mean_range_pct

robustness.dependence_note: One position at a time and a mean holding period of tens of hours mean trades are mechanically separated, not independent draws. No interval estimate is reported for that reason.
robustness.window_structure_note: Windows are sequential periods of one continuous series, not independent samples. Per-window figures describe spread, not significance.
